admission_requirements.general_requirements: Secondary school certificate (Al Tawjihi) or equivalent
admission_requirements.english_requirement: Not required for undergraduate admission; required for postgraduate programs (TOEFL iBT 59-90 or IELTS 5-6.5 depending on specialization)

tuition_fees.medical_majors_fees: Pharmacy: 110 JOD/hour (165 credit hours); Nursing: 65 JOD/hour (132 credit hours)
tuition_fees.engineering_majors_fees: Civil Engineering: 110 JOD/hour (162 hours); Electrical/Mechanical: 100 JOD/hour (160 hours); Alternative Energy: 80 JOD/hour (132 hours); Architectural Engineering: 120 JOD/hour (167 hours)
tuition_fees.humanities_majors_fees: Arabic Literature: 45 JOD/hour; English Literature/Translation: 65 JOD/hour; Classroom Teacher: 50 JOD/hour; Law: 55 JOD/hour
tuition_fees.notes: Credit-hour system. Registration fee: ~370 JOD/semester. Additional fees: 65 JOD. Scholarships: 40% for Tawjihi 90%+, 25% for top student per specialization, 15% for military/security families and persons with disabilities, 10-20% sibling discounts.

ranking_accreditation.accreditation: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MOHE), ABET (for selected engineering programs), ISO 9001, ISO 21001
ranking_accreditation.international_recognition: Times Higher Education World University Rankings 801-1000th (2026); QS World University Rankings 1201-1400 (2026); Member of IAU, FUIW, AArU

campus_facilities.accommodation_details: No on-campus student housing confirmed; dormitory design exists as an engineering student project only
campus_facilities.scholarship_details: Discounts available: 40% for students with Tawjihi average 90%+, 25% for top student per specialization, 15% for military/security personnel families and persons with disabilities, 10-20% sibling discounts for second to fourth siblings

contact_info.address: Queen Alia Airport Road, P.O. Box 130, Amman 11733, Jordan
